messages:
maria: kicking off a config-only change for routing weights and batching caps to trim p99 tail during microbursts. starting canary now.
deploy-bot: deploy queued (cfg-id: microburst-trim-2026-03-21), mode=config-only, env=prod, canary=5% us-west-2 for 12m
josh: noted. monitoring p99_gen, queue_depth, and kvcache_evictions. set grafana dashboard to 15s refresh.
sam: quick validation plan: 1) small prompt smoke 2) 10-concurrent multi-tenant stress 3) embedding sanity check
lee: alert update: raising queue depth alert to 2x baseline for 3m during canary window to avoid noisy signals.
maria: config snapshot below; primary changes = reduce per-tenant inflight, tighten start timeout, lower max batch size for latency tradeoff
```
version: cfg-microburst-trim-2026-03-21
routing:
  primary_policy: latency-weighted
  fallback_order: [local, regional, remote]
limits:
  per_tenant_max_inflight: 40    # was 90
  tenant_floor_concurrency: 4
timeouts:
  start_to_first_token_ms: 1000  # was 1800
  kv_idle_seconds: 50           # was 65
batching:
  max_batch_size: 48            # was 96
  batch_timeout_ms: 20
metrics:
  health_p95_target_ms: 400
```
josh: does not touch model version pins, right? want to avoid accidental promotions during rollout.
maria: confirmed: no model pin changes, only runtime config adjustments.
sre-bot: entry created: microburst-trim-2026-03-21 started by maria. auto-rollback triggers: p99_gen > 800ms for 5m OR error_rate increase > 0.7% sustained 3m.
deploy-bot: canary started at 5% -> target region us-west-2. canary id=cfg-1763
lee: canary metrics at +6m: p99_gen=460ms (baseline 380), kvcache_evictions +8%, one shard reporting transient reconnects
maria: hold ramp. pausing progression to 25%. leave canary at 5% while we investigate.
sam: running stress flow now to reproduce. posting results in 2m.
josh: logs show kvcache pressure correlated with batch size reduction on heavy long-context flows; eviction pattern on older keys.
lee: rolling a conservative tweak: increase kv_idle_seconds to 60 to give more affinity while we dig in. applying patch to canary config.
deploy-bot: config patch applied (cfg-id: microburst-trim-2026-03-21-v1), kv_idle_seconds=60. restarting health probes.
maria: thanks. once we see p99 within 10% and evictions down, we can continue ramp. keep close watch on regen token counts.
lee: +10m probe: p99=390ms, kvcache_evictions down to +2% vs baseline, no reconnects in last 8m.
sam: stress tests passed: multi-tenant 10-concurrent flows no failures, embedding path latency normal.
josh: happy to resume. propose ramp to 25% in 5m, then 60% at +45m if all green, full at +120m.
maria: proceed with that plan. remember to annotate release notes and update the rollout spreadsheet.
sre-bot: reminder: rollback command = /deploy rollback cfg-1763 -> snapshot-prev. auto-snapshot created at deploy start.
deploy-bot: ramping to 25% per schedule.
lee: monitoring; will post 5m aggregation and notify if any shard crosses thresholds.
maria: final note for release note: "microburst-trim: adjusted per-tenant inflight limits, reduced max batch size and tightened start timeout to improve tail latency; temporary kv idle tweak to preserve shard affinity during rollout."
josh: copying that into the release notes doc.
sam: once full ramp completes I'll run a broader tenant smoke sweep and close the thread.
maria: thanks everyone. keeping the thread open until +130m for handoff. :thumbsup:
